cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a bridal dress shop — white gowns on mannequins, a fitting platform, a tall mirror and bolts of lace
cuts.scene: she is a designer sitting sideways on a chair, measuring a length of lace with a tape held in both hands, delighted
cuts.outfit: a bridal seamstress look fitted to her body — a fitted silky sleeveless top and short flared skirt with a pincushion bracelet, bare shoulders and legs, a flowing ribbon tail trailing from her sash
